newsitem.title: MEXICO: Street vendors cost Mexico 20.63 bln pesos in '96.
newsitem.headline: Street vendors cost Mexico 20.63 bln pesos in '96.

text.p: Tax evasion by street merchants cost Mexico 20.635 billion pesos in lost taxes in 1996, the Confederation of National Chambers of Commerce (Concanaco) said on Wednesday.
The 1996 total compares with the confederation's estimate of 18.167 billion pesos lost in 1995, the group said in a statement.
"We expect the national level of street vendors to grow at a rate of 13.6 percent annually, while the formal sector grows at a rate of 7.4 percent," the group said in a study.
The confederation said a large part of the merchandise sold on the streets is stolen, often from cargo trucks robbed on freeways.
